title: Ortograpiyang Pambansa
description: Ang opisyal na pamantayan sa wastong pagbabaybay ng wikang Filipino batay sa KWF 2013. Mula sa alpabeto hanggang sa mga bantas at pangalan.
outcomes: Use the 28-letter Filipino alphabet and the four tuldik correctly
Spell out loud and write down borrowed words the way the KWF prescribes
Choose between din/rin, daw/raw, and ng/nang without guessing
Punctuate with tuldok, kuwit, tuldok-kuwit, and padamdam, and hyphenate correctly
Write the names of people, places, and organizations, and spell out numbers in Filipino
